items.q:
Which change fixes the error in this sentence?

Each of the modules were tested yesterday.
items.explain: The subject is 'each' (singular), not 'modules', so the verb must be 'was'; a plural noun inside a prepositional phrase does not change the verb.

items.q: You are emailing a client in the US asking for comments on a draft. Which line reads as standard written English?
options: Please share your comments by Thursday.
I am having a doubt regarding the API.
Kindly revert back at the earliest.
items.explain: 'Revert back', 'do the needful' and 'having a doubt' are Indian-English usages that confuse many overseas readers; a plain request with a date is clearest.

items.q: You need your lead to review the Payment API design document (version 2) before Friday. Which subject line is best?
options: Review needed by Fri: Payment API design v2
items.explain: A good subject line says what, which version and by when, so it can be found and prioritised without opening the mail.

items.q: Which line says the same thing most clearly?
options: As discussed on the call, the report is attached.
As per our telephonic conversation, I hereby attach the same for perusal.
This is to inform you that the report is being attached.
With reference to the call, please find attached herewith the same.
items.explain: Formal filler ('hereby', 'the same', 'kind perusal') adds words without meaning; a short sentence with the key fact reads as more professional, not less.

items.q: You will miss Tuesday's deadline because a load test found a memory leak. Which message to your manager is best?
options: Sorry sir, some issue came, will try to finish.
Load test found a memory leak; other items done. Thursday OK?
I'll send it whenever it is done.
Deadline can't be met. Not my fault, the API team delayed us.
items.explain: State the cause, the new date, what is already done and ask for agreement; blame, vagueness and apology without a plan all leave the manager with nothing to act on.

items.q: Which is the best README wording for the setup step?
options: First of all you have to install the needed dependencies, then start.
Installation of dependencies is to be done, followed by starting.
The user should now be installing packages via npm and starting.
items.explain: README instructions use short imperative sentences with the exact command, so a reader can follow them without interpreting.

items.q:
Which word should be removed from this sentence?

Let us discuss about the issue in tomorrow's stand-up.
items.explain: 'Discuss' takes a direct object ('discuss the issue'); 'discuss about' is a common slip that stands out in written work.

items.q:
Which change fixes this sentence?

I have been working at this company since three years.
items.explain: 'Since' takes a starting point (since 2023); 'for' takes a duration (for three years).

items.q: Your draft says: 'Please revert with the logs.' In standard English 'revert' means to go back to an earlier state. Which word should replace it?
items.explain: 'Revert' meaning 'reply' is Indian office usage; overseas readers may read it as 'undo', so 'reply' or 'get back to me' is safer.

items.q:
Which is the tightest rewrite of:

Due to the fact that the server was down, we were not in a position to deploy.
options: The server was down and therefore we could not do deployment.
Owing to the server being down, deployment was not possible.
Since the server had gone down, we were unable to be deploying.
Because the server was down, we could not deploy.
items.explain: 'Due to the fact that' is 'because' and 'not in a position to' is 'could not'; cutting filler makes status updates easier to scan.

items.q: You are writing to Priya Nair, the hiring manager, whose name is on the job post. Which salutation is best?
items.explain: When the name is known, use it with a title; 'Respected Madam' reads as dated, 'Sir/Madam' ignores the name, and a bare surname is too casual.
